chapters.title: Find your way around
chapters.text: Manage learners, administrators and employers here. The summary cards filter the directory by role or active programme.

chapters.title: Search and filter
chapters.text: Search names, email addresses, groups or programmes. Open Filters, choose your criteria and select Apply filters. Clear all resets them.

chapters.title: Open and edit records
chapters.text: View opens the learner workspace or employer page. The pencil edits details. More actions contains additional options for that record.

chapters.title: Create and import users
chapters.text: Create user offers the supported user types. Upload learners opens the import process. Review the information before submitting.

chapters.title: Directory tools
chapters.text: Columns changes the visible fields. Export downloads the current results. Administrative tools include bulk actions and the form builders.

chapters.title: Understand the bookings list
chapters.text: Review first-session bookings, including past and cancelled sessions. The summary shows scheduled, awaiting-approval and completed bookings.

chapters.title: Narrow the results
chapters.text: Filter by case owner, programme, session dates or booking dates. Status buttons narrow the list further. Clear filters restores all bookings.

chapters.title: Read a booking
chapters.text: Each row shows the learner, programme, owner, booking date, session date and time. Session times are displayed in UK time.

chapters.title: Open a session
chapters.text: Open the learner record for more detail. An available meeting link opens Teams. A booking status does not confirm every attendee has accepted.

chapters.title: Browse coaches
chapters.text: Find coaches and their public booking pages. Search by name or link, sort by name, and filter by available booking type.

chapters.title: Choose a layout
chapters.text: Switch between List and Cards. Each coach shows the booking options configured for their public page.

chapters.title: Preview or share a booking page
chapters.text: Preview opens the public booking page. Copy page link lets you share it. Confirm availability before promising a learner a slot.

chapters.title: Add and update a coach
chapters.text: Add coach opens the editor. Enter the coach name and booking URLs, then Save coach. Edit updates an existing entry.

chapters.title: Remove an entry
chapters.text: Remove coach asks for confirmation before deleting a directory entry. Check the coach name and the effect on shared links before confirming.

chapters.title: Review transfer requests
chapters.text: Administrators review requests to move learning progress from the old LMS into new modules. Pending and Approved separate requests by status.

chapters.title: Find a request
chapters.text: Search the retrieved requests, filter by programme and change the sort order. Use pagination and retrieval controls when more requests are available.

chapters.title: Check component matching
chapters.text: Review transfer opens the old and new module components. Move between weeks and check the proposed matches. Review existing completions before making changes.

chapters.title: Approve a transfer
chapters.text: Approve transfer applies the reviewed mappings. Check the learner and module carefully. Cancel closes the review without approving the request.

chapters.title: Check history and refresh
chapters.text: Approved shows completed requests. Export log downloads the transfer log. Refresh retrieves current requests; use Retry refresh if the service fails.

chapters.title: Your own learning
chapters.text: This is the administrator's personal learning space. Courses you have joined as a learner appear here. Previewing a course does not enrol you.

chapters.title: Read your progress
chapters.text: Each course card shows its title and available progress information. Use the progress summary to see how much tracked learning is complete.

chapters.title: Explore a course outline
chapters.text: Expand the course outline to see its weeks and activities. This helps you check the content before continuing your learning.

chapters.title: Continue and refresh
chapters.text: Continue learning opens the learner course pages. Refresh updates your courses. If loading fails, Try again retries the request.

chapters.title: Review the learner record
chapters.text: Check the learner identity, programme, owner and onboarding status. Overview brings together contact details, programme information, contacts and notes.

chapters.title: Review enrolment answers
chapters.text: Show wizard opens the learner's enrolment form. Check the correct learner and delivery type before editing. Return here with Close wizard.

chapters.title: Documents and signatures
chapters.text: For apprenticeship learners, Documents contains compliance paperwork, reviews and uploads. Check document status and signatures before issuing or signing anything.

chapters.title: Skills and progress
chapters.text: Skills & progress brings together recorded competencies and course progress. Use the available training-plan actions to review or build the learner's plan.

chapters.title: Activity and completion
chapters.text: Activity shows the recorded history. Finish enrolment is a separate action: review the required information and document status before completing it.

chapters.title: Welcome and navigation
chapters.text: Review this learner's enrolment answers step by step. Use the step navigation and progress indicators. Close wizard returns to the learner record.

chapters.title: Before you begin
chapters.text: Read the preparation guidance before entering information. Check which details and evidence are needed. The published form controls the steps and questions shown.

chapters.title: Personal details
chapters.text: Check the learner's name, contact details and other personal information. Required questions and format messages help identify incomplete or invalid answers.

chapters.title: ILR learner details
chapters.text: For apprenticeship learners, review the Individualised Learner Record details. Check the learner's declarations and evidence; do not guess missing information.

chapters.title: Extended ILR
chapters.text: Review the additional funding and learner information shown in this step. Complete applicable follow-up questions and declarations. Commercial enrolment skips the ILR steps.

chapters.title: CV and job description
chapters.text: Review the learner's experience and the CV or job-description evidence requested by this form. Check uploaded evidence before moving on.

chapters.title: Personal Learning Record
chapters.text: Review prior qualifications and the Personal Learning Record information. Check the evidence and any details already captured for the learner.

chapters.title: Skills Radar
chapters.text: Review the learner's self-assessment against the programme competencies. Staff review mode preserves the learner's own responses rather than replacing their ratings.

chapters.title: Inclusion
chapters.text: Review the inclusion guidance and recorded assessment status. This status comes from the connected safeguarding assessment, rather than a status you can invent here.

chapters.title: Policies
chapters.text: Review the policy documents and required acknowledgements. Read each document before confirming that it has been understood.

chapters.title: Next steps and submission
chapters.text: Read what happens next and review incomplete steps. Submit only after checking the learner's information. A successful submission returns you to the profile.

chapters.title: Edit the published form
chapters.text: This editor controls the apprenticeship enrolment wizard. Work on a draft copy of the published layout. Changes reach learners when you publish.

chapters.title: Organise steps and questions
chapters.text: Select a step to review its questions and content. Use the available ordering and editing controls. Some built-in items have restrictions.

chapters.title: Configure form fields
chapters.text: Add supported custom fields, edit labels and text, and choose optional or mandatory where available. Check conditional questions and their dependencies.

chapters.title: Review before publishing
chapters.text: Review the draft and the publish confirmation carefully. Publishing affects the shared form. Removing a published field hides it while preserving its stored answers.

chapters.title: Manage the application form
chapters.text: This editor controls the public apprenticeship eligibility form. Page text, sections and questions are edited in a draft before publication.

chapters.title: Organise sections
chapters.text: Select a section to review its questions and guidance. Use the available controls to edit or reorder sections and the questions within them.

chapters.title: Edit questions and choices
chapters.text: Configure supported question types, labels, choices and conditions. Review required questions and dependencies. Built-in questions may have additional restrictions.

chapters.title: Publish the reviewed draft
chapters.text: Check the draft and publish confirmation before updating the public form. Removing a published question preserves its stored answers. Resolve validation messages before publishing.

chapters.title: Choose the learner placement
chapters.text: Build or edit this learner's training plan. Choose the programme and applicable cohort and group. Check the learner name before continuing.

chapters.title: Build the learning content
chapters.text: Add modules from the selected programme. Each module brings its authored weeks and activities. Check the content counts and planned hours.

chapters.title: Review and save
chapters.text: Review the full plan before saving. Back returns to an earlier step. Saving applies the plan to this learner, so check the placement and content carefully.
